alternative.product: Aldi Magnum Original Washing Up Liquid, 500ml

summary: Fairy beat Aldi 84% to 78% in Which?'s test, and costs 48p against 12p per 100ml.
evidence: Which? washing-up liquid test, tested April 2026, page checked July 2026: 14 products listed. Fairy Max Power Eucalyptus 84%, 48p per 100ml for 730ml. Aldi Magnum Original 78%, 62p for 500ml (12p per 100ml), in store only. Which? prints no shelf price for Fairy, so the £3.50 is our sum from 48p per 100ml. The test table is locked to members, so the Fairy score comes from Which?'s article of 3 August 2026 and the Aldi score from its roundup of 29 October 2026. The two prices may be from different chains.
differences: Fairy won by six points and Which? calls it the top performer in its tests. Which? says it cleaned 46 plates at 35°C and 65 at 45°C, more than any other liquid, so it may go further per squirt, and the saving per wash-up may be smaller than per 100ml. Aldi's plate count is members-only. Which? also says the Fairy contains substances harmful to aquatic life. The Fairy is sold as antibacterial and the Aldi liquid isn't.
why: The brand won here, by six points, at four times the price per 100ml. Which? also says there's no need to buy a special antibacterial washing-up liquid, and it rates Aldi's a Best Buy too.
